agents.role: Local evidence mapper — files, configs, source facts

agents.name: Synthesizer
agents.role: Fan-in decision — lanes into one memo

playbooks.label: 01-discovery
playbooks.objective: Discovery: take a product brief and produce a Go/No-Go memo with PRD, UX sketch, monetization model, and market evidence. Read-only. Human gate before any build.

playbooks.label: 02-build
playbooks.objective: Build (mindful-break): hourly break widget + breathing screen + on-device streak, zero backend. Approved PRD: products/mindful-break/BRIEF.md.

playbooks.label: 03-release
playbooks.objective: Release readiness: verify a product is safe to submit to Google Play and the App Store. Read-only plus named verification commands. Produces a GO/NO-GO release verdict.

playbooks.label: 04-aso-audit
playbooks.objective: ASO audit: audit one product's store presence and produce a prioritized ASO action list. Read-only; web research only if extension tools are granted at start time with live catalog provenance.

playbooks.label: 05-localize-it
playbooks.objective: Italian localization: produce a native-quality Italian locale bundle for one product. Scoped mutation limited to locale files named in the kickoff message.

playbooks.label: 06-ideate
playbooks.objective: Ideation: scan trends, brainstorm 5+ concepts from a market gap, and score them. Read-only. Produces a ranked shortlist for the Director to fund.

playbooks.label: 07-backend-ideate
playbooks.objective: Backend-Enabled Ideation: scan trends, brainstorm 5+ concepts that leverage a back-end server (multi-user, real-time, cloud sync, hosted AI, community), and score them. Read-only. Produces a ranked shortlist for the Director to fund.

playbooks.label: 07-innovation-sprint
playbooks.objective: Build Hourly Wellness Widget – zero-backend PWA/TWA widget that reminds users to take a 60-second breathing break every hour, with a guided breathing canvas, localStorage streak tracking, and optional home-screen widget.

playbooks.label: 09-innovation-sprint-focus-lens
playbooks.objective: Privacy Dashboard for productivity monitoring, with end-to-end encryption and granular data controls

playbooks.label: 09-innovation-sprint-silent-voice-reader
playbooks.objective: voice-controlled silent reading experience with privacy-first design, audio processing, and distraction-free reading interface
